name: Movie & Series Vault
description: Download direct videos or .zip/.rar web series packs to your Google Drive Movies folder, with optional AES-256-GCM filename and stream encryption.

inputs.label: Movie or Archive URL
inputs.description: Direct link to a video file (.mp4, .mkv, .avi) or multi-episode .zip/.rar archive.

inputs.label: Movie / Series Title (Optional)
inputs.placeholder: Auto-detect from file or archive name
inputs.description: Optional display title (used as series title when unpacking .zip/.rar episodes).

inputs.label: Google Drive Folder
inputs.description: Target Drive folder scanned by the built-in Netflix-style Movies streamer.

inputs.label: Encrypt Video & Filename (Zero-Knowledge)
inputs.description: Encrypts titles, metadata, and streamable 1 MB AES-256-GCM blocks so Google Drive cannot scan or open your videos.

inputs.label: Extract .zip / .rar Archives (Web Series)
inputs.description: Unpacks .zip/.rar/.7z archives in Colab temp storage so every episode can be streamed individually.

outputs.label: Upload Status
outputs.description: Processed files and Drive vault targets
